lines.zh: 我把速度提了一档，风让开
lines.en: I kick up the speed and the wind gives way.
My shadow can't keep up with my toes.

lines.zh: 我贴着一道山脊掠过去
lines.en: I skim along a ridge line.
This GT me flies harder.

lines.zh: 气流在身后拉成一条线
lines.en: Airflow trails behind me in a line.
I bank aside to clear a tall tree.
There's no road below, and none needed.
I flick my fringe aside.

lines.zh: 我往前一送，就过了半座山
lines.en: One push and I'm past half a mountain.
The wind pulls my hem taut.
I can't be bothered to go around.
Speed is my kind of courtesy.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，气收得很稳
lines.en: I hang in the air, ki held steady.
My ki is deeper than it used to be.
This world is still so noisy.
I look at my own hand.

lines.zh: 人造人的身体，一样不吃不睡
lines.en: Android body: still no food, no sleep.
The wind passes through my hair.
I settle my ki in one quick pass.
No one's worth me waiting this long.
I settle my weight back onto my soles.
Silence suits me better.
These clouds don't block my view.

lines.zh: 我记得的战斗比这多得多
lines.en: I've seen far more fighting than this.
I lift my chin toward the horizon.
No rush. Time is on my side.
The ki on you isn't nearly enough.
I look you over, boots to scalp.

lines.zh: 你认识我吗？最好不认识
lines.en: Do you know me? Better if you don't.
That look says you want to try.

lines.zh: 我认得比我弱的人怎么站
lines.en: I know how the weaker ones stand.
Your hand is trembling badly.
I sink slowly to your eye level.
You really think I only take hits?
My kicks need no charge.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就当你怕了
lines.en: Half a step back and I'll call it fear.
Have you got a good look at this face?

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，气收在掌里
lines.en: I hover above you, ki gathered in my palm.

lines.zh: 你的气往回收了，很聪明
lines.en: Your ki pulled back. Smart.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，记下你的破绽
lines.en: I narrow my eyes and mark your opening.

lines.zh: 别用那种口气跟我说话
lines.en: Don't use that tone with me.
I don't feel like a single word.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我下面
lines.en: You're standing directly beneath me.
All right. I've seen enough.
I turn my head and miss it by an inch.
That one landed. I'll give you that.
My ki scattered for an instant.
I pull back to reset the distance.
Blood seeps from the corner of my mouth.
You're faster than a moment ago.
It hurts, but I won't cry out.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
Fine. Now it's my turn.
You've managed to annoy me.

lines.zh: 你拿什么来，都留不住我
lines.en: Whatever you offer won't keep me here.
I don't eat. Forgotten that?
You call that a lure?
I drift near; it's on my way.

lines.zh: 你举得那么高，想给谁看
lines.en: Holding it high — who's it for?
Don't trade that for my patience.
I smell it. I don't care.
Keep it yourself, human.

lines.zh: 我落低一点，看看你想干嘛
lines.en: I drop lower to see what you're up to.
That trick does nothing to me.
You run into my wall of ki.
My ki bounces you back half a block.
Don't touch me. I'm not used to it.
You hit and back off. Sensible.
I drop my shoulder and you stagger.
We pass close; the wind cracks loud.
You can't even knock me off balance.
Three blocks back before we talk.
I'll pretend that didn't happen.
Don't try that twice.
You'd have to match my speed.
I don't need anyone taking hits for me.
When we fly together, don't talk.
Your ki is steadier than most.
I'm not used to such words.
Strong wind. Come a bit closer.
I won't soften. Don't expect it.
If we go together, don't lag.
Hold out your hand. Once.
This road isn't bad with two.
I lift it with two fingers.
This has some weight to it.
Wasteful to leave it lying there.
I turn my wrist and pocket it.
An android's hand can catch it.
Not what I wanted, but usable.
Bending down took half a second.
Don't think I'm picking it up for you.
Useful things shouldn't go to waste.
I'll hold it. We'll see later.
Your ki moved, so I moved.
This time I strike first.
Locked on. No point hiding.
I climb, then dive.
A Destructo Disc opens the way.
Your reaction is half a beat late.
I've already planned your retreat.
My kick combo starts at your knees.
Don't look up. I'm right above.
You're a little bit interesting.
I'll give you one chance. Run.
You're already in my hands.
The ki blast is chambered.
No more probing this time.
The target is you, no one else.
I count to one and move.
I trace an arc above you.
You shift; I shift with you.

lines.zh: 我贴着云压下去，找角度
lines.en: I drop along the cloud line, hunting an angle.

lines.zh: 我等的就是你抬手那刻
lines.en: I'm waiting for the moment you raise a hand.
Ki blasts come from three directions.
You guard the front. The side?
I won't land, so you can't reach me.
Your armour — there's the seam.
I'm timing the gaps in your breathing.
A little longer and you'll break rhythm.
I can see your ki shrinking.
This flanking move, you can't block.
I'm not rushed. You are.
I let the wind keep an eye on you.
Your feet are already retreating.
I want you looking up for me.
This strike is aimed at your collarbone.
Time's up. Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 一记旋踢扫过你的脖子
lines.en: A spinning kick sweeps past your neck.

lines.zh: 连踢三下，最后一下最重
lines.en: Three kicks, the last one heaviest.
The disc shears off your shoulder plate.
My elbow slams into your chest.
A ki blast bursts along the ground.
You block the fist, not the knee.
I come down from above.
This kick lifts you off the ground.
I strike twice as fast as you.
Your weapon goes flying.
I strike from right behind you.
A ki wave pushes you sliding back.
Your armour has a dent now.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，你已经倒了
lines.en: When I land, you're already down.
I used half my strength there.
Don't rush. There's more coming.
I push the clouds aside and drop in.
The GT me arrives faster.

lines.zh: 这里的重力，几乎不算什么
lines.en: The gravity here barely counts.
Someone called me here.

lines.zh: 我在半空停了一下，看你
lines.en: I pause mid-air and look at you.
Blonde hair, blue eyes. Don't misremember.
I don't often come to places like this.
This is the address on the mission.
There's blood in the air.
I don't plan to stay long.
That flash was a ki blast.

lines.zh: 我脚下的地面裂了一圈
lines.en: The ground cracks in a ring beneath me.
Bad luck. You ran into me.
This jacket fits well, doesn't it?
Don't ask who I am. No use.
I scan around. Very empty.
Fine. Let's begin.
The wind stopped. I'm here.

lines.zh: 火焰卷上来，我只皱了眉
lines.en: Flames lick up; I only frown.
I hit a cliff face and rubble sprays.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我挣着上浮
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I fight to rise.
The blast wave throws me a dozen blocks.
The arrowhead is stuck in my shoulder blade.
That attack has no shape to block.
My body idles and my ki drains.
Lightning strikes me square on the back.
No bottom below; I just keep falling.
